title: React Compiler Verification
description: Test and compare performance with React Compiler enabled/disabled
scenario1Desc: List with 1000 items. Filter and click to select.
scenario2Desc: Data updates every second. Observe render performance.
scenario3Desc: Multiple linked counters. Click to increment.
instruction1: Open this page in two browser tabs
instruction2: In one tab, enable React Compiler (ENABLE_REACT_COMPILER=true)
instruction3: In other tab, disable React Compiler (ENABLE_REACT_COMPILER=false)
instruction4: Run same operations in both tabs (click buttons, filter, etc.)
instruction5: Compare render counts and FPS to see performance difference
instruction6: Use React DevTools Profiler for detailed analysis
